title: Failure: a Relata sink with an invalid token fails honestly
summary: Submits http -> relata with an invalid token written in the TOML. Relata refuses every write, so the run must not be COMPLETED, records_failed must be above 0, nothing may land in Relata, and the token must not appear anywhere in the run record or task result.

steps.title: Count Relata chunks (Before)
steps.explain: Relata DocumentChunk row count before the run.

args.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM DocumentChunk

steps.title: Submit the job through the API
steps.explain: POST /api/v1/jobs with the TOML base64-encoded, exactly as the console does.

steps.title: Wait for the run to finish
steps.explain: Polls the task result and GET /api/v1/runs until this run reaches a terminal status.

steps.title: Run is FAILED or PARTIAL
steps.explain: A run where no record landed must not say COMPLETED.

steps.title: records_failed is above 0
steps.explain: The refused records must be counted.

steps.title: The error names the 401 from Relata
The token is absent from the run record and task result
steps.explain: A secret written in the TOML must never be stored or returned.

steps.title: Count Relata chunks (After)
steps.explain: Relata DocumentChunk row count after the run.

args.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM DocumentChunk

steps.title: Relata gained no chunks
steps.explain: A refused write must store nothing.
